scripts.test:a11y: rm -rf .vitest/a11y .vitest/a11y-focus && A11Y=1 vitest run --project examples; node scripts/a11y-report.mjs
scripts.test:motion: rm -rf .vitest/motion && MOTION=1 vitest run --project examples; node scripts/a11y-report.mjs
scripts.test:text: rm -rf .vitest/text && TEXT=1 vitest run --project examples; node scripts/a11y-report.mjs
scripts.test:responsive: rm -rf .vitest/responsive && for width in 320 768 1440; do WIDTH=$width vitest run --project examples; done; node scripts/a11y-report.mjs
scripts.test:rtl: rm -rf .vitest/rtl && RTL=1 vitest run --project examples; node scripts/check-rtl.mjs; node scripts/a11y-report.mjs
scripts.test:long-text: rm -rf .vitest/long-text && LONG_TEXT=1 vitest run --project examples; node scripts/a11y-report.mjs
scripts.test:perf: rm -rf .vitest/perf && PERF=1 vitest run --project perf; node scripts/perf-report.mjs
